item.title: How a sex scandal at Nvidia is putting pressure on the White House
item.description: Jensen Huang's personal life may have triggered the crisis, but the questions now reach into the White House itself.

item.title: Ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to testify before Congress about affair with alleged Chinese spy
item.description: Huang abruptly quit on Thursday as head of one of the world's most valuable companies after revelations of alleged extramarital affairs.

item.title: Bessent blames Lutnick's Commerce Department for failing to block Megaspeed
item.description: Scott Bessent told CNBC that several government agencies "were in favour of putting Megaspeed on the entity list for months".

item.title: 'How does a building just fall?' Neighbours grieve after deadly Brooklyn building collapse
item.description: The accident rattled the usually calm immigrant neighbourhood of Flatbush, New York. At least eight residents, including two children, died in the rubble.

item.title: New York Mayor Mamdani praises 'heroism' of building collapse responders
item.description: "People are alive today due to their heroism yesterday," Mamdani tells reporters at a news conference.

item.title: US doctor kills building manager after long-running dispute over mould, police say
item.description: Authorities say the shooting in Washington DC left four people injured, with the suspect dying of a self-inflicted gunshot wound.

item.title: Why midterm vote-counting is taking so long in America's largest state
item.description: Alaskans are still waiting for the full results, including in the close Senate race between Republican Dan Sullivan and Democrat Mary Peltola.

item.title: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
item.description: Specialist Thomas Iglesias had shouted at Hegseth's group to be quiet after they could be heard talking and laughing at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

item.title: Military cemetery decorum: The tradition behind Hegseth's Veterans Day reprimand
item.description: BBC's Bernd Debusmann breaks down why Defence Secretary Hegseth's group was reprimanded at Arlington National Cemetery and the history behind its strict rules of conduct.

item.title: Before Scott Colom, these two men were the last black US senators from Mississippi
item.description: The Democratic candidate won in a southern state that had not seated a black senator since 1874.

item.title: What we know about Brooklyn building collapse that killed eight people
item.description: Two construction workers and two children were killed when a residential building fell into an adjacent construction site on Wednesday.

item.title: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent relocated after alleged Iranian threats
item.description: Bessent is now one of several Trump administration officials to live on military bases due to safety concerns.

item.title: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century
item.description: In a state Trump won two years ago by 22 points, Colom's victory extends a string of Democratic wins in the Senate.

item.title: Missing 11-month-old baby rescued after being buried alive in a crate in South Carolina
item.description: Officials say the child was found close to his father's home on Tuesday, a day after he was taken, and is being cared for in hospital.

item.title: Famed ship SS United States deliberately sunk off Florida coast to become a reef
item.description: Activists wanted the historic liner to be turned into a museum, but it will instead become the world's largest artificial ocean reef.

item.title: Lego marketplace BrickLink offline after 'unusual activity' detected
item.description: Known as the eBay of Lego, it has been down for three days and is yet to disclose what caused the shutdown.

item.title: How could the Nvidia CEO’s affair threaten US national security?
item.description: BBC's Asma Khalid explains how the Nvidia affair could threaten US national security and risk sensitive US technology getting into China.

item.title: 'We just ran' - One killed, four injured in shooting near Washington DC gym
item.description: The shooting began Thursday morning local time at a gym in an apartment building about a mile (1.6km) north of the White House.

item.title: Why Democrat Scott Colom’s win in Mississippi Senate race is so significant
item.description: Colom's victory makes him the first black person from the state to be elected to the US Senate in more than 140 years.

item.title: Watch: Moment Hegseth's group reprimanded at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
item.description: Following a ceremony marking Veterans Day, a group that included Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth was shouted at to be quiet.

item.title: Survivor pulled from rubble of deadly building collapse in New York
item.description: Two people are dead and several others injured as rescuers scour the debris in Brooklyn.

item.title: Trump says 'we won' Iran war during Veterans Day service
item.description: US President Donald Trump placed a wreath at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier before making remarks at the Veterans Day ceremony at Arlington National Cemetery.

item.title: The rise and fall of Jensen Huang - how the tech superstar became mired in scandal
item.description: Within days, Huang's status as a seemingly untouchable figure leading the global tech race has crumbled.

item.title: Who is Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress - and who could take over permanently?
item.description: Chief financial officer Colette Kress in in charge of Nvidia for now, but several others are in the frame as potential successors.

item.title: What we know as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns over affair allegations
item.description: The billionaire tech executive has left the company following reports of a second extramarital affair.

item.title: Analysis: Hegseth fights for his political life with appeal to Trump
item.description: The defence secretary may be facing impeachment, writes Gary O'Donoghue, but it is Trump who could determine his fate.

item.title: US inflation higher than expected in October - here's what is happening with prices
item.description: Prices rose by 0.4% over the month, driven by increases in shelter, food and energy costs.

item.title: Meet Stephanie Case - the Canadian first woman to run 100 miles in Antarctica
item.description: Stephanie Case makes history by becoming the first woman to complete extreme 100-mile race in Antarctica.

item.title: The Trump coalition is shattered - what will Republicans do now?
item.description: Republicans can stick with Trumpism or chart a new path, writes BBC Washington correspondent Daniel Bush.
